question: In evidence.zip, Use the unique d27-- member whose basename ends cc.elf. Read the dynamic section and classify the symbol hash table style: gnu when only DT_GNU_HASH is present, sysv when only DT_HASH is present, both when both are, none when neither.
generator_cmd: sh tc_gen.sh  # gcc -g -Wl,--hash-style=gnu | gcc -S + as --gstabs + gcc -Wl,--hash-style=sysv | gcc -Wl,--hash-style=both
oracle_cmd: sh -c 't=$(readelf -d gf_tc_both.elf | grep -oE "\((GNU_)?HASH\)" | sort | tr -d "\n"); case $t in "(GNU_HASH)(HASH)") echo both;; "(GNU_HASH)") echo gnu;; "(HASH)") echo sysv;; *) echo none;; esac'
